title: Mirabel and the Salt
author: Noor Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Iversen, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
